Swiss Army Bench 0.0.26

- **Projects has a page of its own.** The red mark is now the first item on the rail, on every page and window,
  and opens **Projects**: your projects, New project, Open project and the tour. The app opens there. The grid
  page is only the grids now; with no table open it offers Open a file, Paste and Query.
- **Smaller rail icons**, so more fit.
- **Sign in with GitHub says why when GitHub refuses**, in plain words (for example, when the app's Enable
  Device Flow box on GitHub is not ticked), instead of "GitHub answered 400".
